Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
Thank you for joining us for yesterday's webinar on "Smarter A/R for a Global Market: AI, Automation, and Cross-Border Payments with Dynamics 365 ERPs."
We hope you found valuable insights on how leading organizations are transforming their invoice-to-cash operations with AI-powered automation and seamless cross-border payment capabilities.
Access the Full Recording Watch the complete session here <[[https://msdynamicsworld.com/video/smarter-ar-global-market-ai-automation-and-cross-border-payments-dynamics-365-erps?check_logged_in=1]]> - perfect for sharing with your team or revisiting key concepts.
Key Takeaways from the Session:
- How to eliminate manual chasing with automated follow-ups and smart task management
- Strategies to boost first-payment conversion by up to 28% with localized payment experiences - Real-time insights that improve collections efficiency and accelerate cash flow - Supporting 1,200+ payment methods across 174 currencies while reducing FX risk
What's Next? If you'd like to explore how these solutions could work specifically for your Dynamics 365 environment, our team would be happy to schedule a personalized discussion about your A/R challenges and goals.
Schedule a consultation <[[https://meet.yesware.com/me/griffin-ortale/30min]]> or simply reply to this email with any questions.
Best regards,
Griffin Ortale Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
